summary: Duke Energy Progress, LLC filed an 8-K with audited financial statements and pro forma information regarding a planned merger into Duke Energy Carolinas, LLC, creating a single electric utility across North Carolina and South Carolina. The transaction requires Duke Energy Corporation to contribute its 100% equity interest in Duke Energy Carolinas to Progress Energy, Inc. prior to the combination. Regulators have approved: FERC on January 30, 2026, NCUC on May 1, 2026, and PSCSC on June 3, 2026. The targeted effective date is January 1, 2027, subject to board approvals and a definitive agreement. Watch for final closing conditions and exact effective date.
